title: Runtime Application Compose Provider Binding Proof Manifest
description: Bounded USF-183 runtime proof manifest for API and worker dev runtime execution with SDK-backed Postgres, Keycloak, Mailpit, MinIO, NATS, Temporal, and OpenBao composed provider bindings, service catalogue traceability, teardown obligations, enterprise evidence posture, and explicit non-claims.
aiGuidance: This manifest supports bounded USF-183 runtime provider-binding proof only. It does not claim full dev readiness, full React parity, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, or ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

assertions: API binds to loopback on an ephemeral port
health route reports dev-in-memory runtime mode
readiness route reports service catalogue authority
OpenAPI route exposes tenant-context
tenant mismatch fails closed
authorization failure fails closed
tenant-context request captures audit evidence
apiProof.auditEvidence: tenant-context audit record count is checked in the API runtime proof
apiProof.tenantBoundary: tenant mismatch request returns a closed failure status
apiProof.accessBoundary: authorization failure request returns a closed failure status
apiProof.secretBoundary: runtime uses only synthetic local seed data and no external provider credentials
apiProof.syntheticDataBoundary: runtime proof sends only synthetic tenant, actor, and job data
apiProof.providerBindingEvidence: API proof verifies in-memory notification provider configuration remains explicit and is not silently treated as composed-backed.

assertions: worker run-once proof starts through the worker entry point
worker submits and executes a synthetic tenant maintenance job
worker cross-tenant job read fails closed
worker authorization failure fails closed
worker job lifecycle produces audit evidence
workerProof.auditEvidence: worker proof requires job lifecycle and denial audit events
workerProof.tenantBoundary: cross-tenant worker job read fails closed
workerProof.accessBoundary: unauthorized worker job submission fails closed
workerProof.secretBoundary: worker proof uses no real secrets or external provider credentials
workerProof.syntheticDataBoundary: worker proof submits synthetic tenant, actor, and job payload data only
workerProof.providerBindingEvidence: Worker proof verifies in-memory notification delivery remains hermetic and reports providerMode in-memory.

teardown.childProcesses: API and worker child processes are stopped in finally paths with SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback.
teardown.composeResources: No Compose resources are started for dev-in-memory mode.

assertions: canonical dev Compose target starts and waits before API proof
API binds to loopback on an ephemeral port
health route reports dev-compose-backed runtime mode
health route reports local-composed-real-service provider mode

file routes write and read synthetic objects through MinioObjectStore

tenant mismatch fails closed
authorization failure fails closed

apiProof.auditEvidence: API proof requires tenant-context, NATS publish, Keycloak identity, MinIO object, Postgres permission, and notification provider metadata evidence while the canonical dev Compose boundary is running.
apiProof.tenantBoundary: tenant mismatch request returns a closed failure status while Compose is running
apiProof.accessBoundary: authorization failure request returns a closed failure status while Compose is running
apiProof.secretBoundary: runtime uses only synthetic local seed data and no external provider credentials
apiProof.syntheticDataBoundary: runtime proof sends only synthetic tenant, actor, and job data

Mailpit delivery, OpenBao, and Temporal have no API route surface in this slice and are proven by the worker proof.

worker run-once proof starts through the worker entry point

worker cross-tenant job read fails closed

workerProof.auditEvidence: worker proof requires job lifecycle, denial, provider configuration, Postgres, Mailpit, NATS, MinIO, Keycloak, OpenBao, and Temporal value-free adapter evidence while the canonical dev Compose boundary is running.
workerProof.tenantBoundary: cross-tenant worker job read fails closed while Compose is running
workerProof.accessBoundary: unauthorized worker job submission fails closed while Compose is running
workerProof.secretBoundary: worker proof uses no real secrets or external provider credentials
workerProof.syntheticDataBoundary: worker proof submits synthetic tenant, actor, and job payload data only
workerProof.providerBindingEvidence: Worker proof verifies all service-catalogue-required runtime provider bindings that have runtime ports: Postgres, Mailpit, NATS, MinIO, Keycloak, OpenBao, and Temporal.

teardown.childProcesses: API and worker child processes are stopped in finally paths with SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback.
teardown.composeResources: The runtime proof starts docker compose with a unique project name and always runs docker compose down with volume and orphan cleanup.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: node-postgres pg is the maintained de-facto standard PostgreSQL client for Node.js and is the Kysely PostgresDialect client boundary used for this local composed proof.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: npm registry metadata inspected on 2026-06-30 reported latest version 8.22.0, MIT license, Node engine >=16.0.0, GitHub repository, and publish/update activity in June 2026.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Adapter output stores endpoint_ref, hashes, row counts, and value-free provider summaries only; raw connection strings, passwords, endpoints, stack traces, and SDK error payloads are not emitted.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: pg is used with exact-pinned @types/pg 8.20.0 for the repo TypeScript 6 posture; SDK imports remain inside adapters/db/src/index.ts.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: pg connects to the loopback-bound Postgres service in compose.dev.generated.yaml with local placeholder credentials and no external network egress.
alternativesRejected: Raw TCP/socket protocol calls were rejected because a maintained client library exists.
Shelling out to psql was rejected for runtime provider proof because the composed adapter must use an SDK/client boundary.
postgres.js was rejected because the repo already uses Kysely and Kysely's documented PostgresDialect integrates directly with pg.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Dedicated Mailpit REST API TypeScript client selected for the Mailpit composed service because no official Mailpit Node SDK is present in the repo.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: npm registry metadata inspected on 2026-06-30 reported latest version 2.1.0, Node engine >=18.0.0, MIT license, GitHub repository, and publish/update activity in June 2026.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Zero runtime dependency package; proof output stores only endpoint_ref, hashes, and value-free provider summaries.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Published package includes TypeScript declaration files and ESM/CJS exports compatible with the repo TypeScript moduleResolution posture.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Mailpit API client targets the loopback-bound Mailpit HTTP API in compose.dev.generated.yaml and uses no external network egress or real credentials.
alternativesRejected: Raw HTTP was rejected because provider clients must use an SDK or client boundary when one is suitable.
Nodemailer was rejected for this proof because it is a generic SMTP client and would not provide Mailpit service readback and cleanup through a service-specific client.
mailpit-ws was rejected because real-time WebSocket events are not required for deterministic API and worker provider proof.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Official nats-io Node transport client selected for local NATS composed proof.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Exact version 3.4.0 is pinned; package is maintained under the nats-io ecosystem and supports current Node runtimes.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Adapter emits endpoint_ref, hashes, counters, and value-free summaries only; raw NATS URLs and payloads are not emitted.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Package ships TypeScript types and is used only through adapters/bus/src/index.ts dynamic adapter import.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Connects to loopback-bound NATS in compose.dev.generated.yaml with no credentials and no external egress.
alternativesRejected: Raw socket protocol calls were rejected because an official client exists.
The deprecated nats package was rejected in favor of the maintained @nats-io transport package.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Official MinIO JavaScript client selected for local MinIO composed proof.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Exact version 8.0.7 is pinned and maintained by MinIO for S3-compatible object-store operations.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Adapter emits endpoint_ref, hashes, byte counts, and value-free summaries only; object keys, credentials, endpoints, and payloads are not emitted.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Package includes TypeScript support and is imported only inside adapters/store/src/index.ts.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Connects to loopback-bound MinIO in compose.dev.generated.yaml with local placeholder credentials and no external egress.
alternativesRejected: Raw S3 HTTP calls were rejected because the official client exists.
AWS SDK was rejected because the composed service is MinIO and the official MinIO client is sufficient for local proof.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Official Keycloak admin client selected for composed Keycloak proof.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Version 26.2.5 is pinned to match the compose Keycloak image version and is maintained by the Keycloak project.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Adapter emits endpoint_ref, hashes, safe reason codes, and value-free summaries only; admin credentials, tokens, endpoints, and SDK error payloads are not emitted.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Official package includes TypeScript declarations and is imported only inside adapters/idp/src/index.ts.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Connects to loopback-bound Keycloak in compose.dev.generated.yaml with local placeholder admin credentials and no external egress.
alternativesRejected: keycloak-js was rejected because it is browser/client oriented and not appropriate for admin-side synthetic identity proof.
Raw HTTP admin API calls were rejected because the official admin client exists.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: De-facto Vault-compatible Node client selected for OpenBao because no mature official OpenBao JavaScript SDK is present.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Exact version 0.12.0 is pinned; OpenBao exposes a Vault-compatible API suitable for this local proof boundary.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Adapter emits endpoint_ref, hashes, safe reason codes, and value-free summaries only; secret values, tokens, endpoints, and SDK error payloads are not emitted.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Used with exact-pinned @types/node-vault through adapters/secrets/src/index.ts only.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Connects to loopback-bound OpenBao dev service in compose.dev.generated.yaml with local placeholder token and no external egress.
alternativesRejected: Raw HTTP was rejected because a suitable Vault-compatible client exists.
Cloud provider secret SDKs were rejected because the composed service is OpenBao.

providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Exact version 1.18.1 is pinned and maintained by Temporal.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Adapter emits endpoint_ref, hashes, safe reason codes, and value-free summaries only; raw workflow ids and SDK errors are not emitted.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Official TypeScript SDK is dynamically imported only inside adapters/wf/src/index.ts.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Connects to loopback-bound Temporal in compose.dev.generated.yaml with no external egress.
alternativesRejected: Raw gRPC calls were rejected because the official SDK exists.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Official Temporal TypeScript worker SDK selected for composed Temporal worker proof.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Exact version 1.18.1 is pinned and maintained by Temporal.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Worker proof emits value-free task queue, workflow, trace, metric, and cleanup evidence only.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Official TypeScript SDK is dynamically imported only inside adapters/wf/src/index.ts.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Runs a one-shot local worker against loopback-bound Temporal with workflow cache disabled for deterministic proof.
alternativesRejected: Hand-rolled worker polling was rejected because the official SDK exists.

providerSdkBoundary.officialOrDefactoStatus: Official Temporal workflow SDK package is pinned as part of the Temporal TypeScript SDK boundary used by the worker bundler.
providerSdkBoundary.maintenanceEvidence: Exact version 1.18.1 is pinned and maintained by Temporal.
providerSdkBoundary.securityPosture: Workflow code uses synthetic hashes only and no provider secrets or external egress.
providerSdkBoundary.typescriptSupport: Package is bundled through the Temporal worker SDK boundary; workflow source remains under adapters/wf/src.
providerSdkBoundary.localComposeCompatibility: Temporal worker bundles the synthetic workflow for local composed proof.

syntheticDataBoundary: Runtime proof sends synthetic tenant ids, actor ids, and job payload markers only.
accessBoundary: API and worker proofs verify fail-closed authorization paths and bind API host exposure to loopback.
auditEvidenceBoundary: API proof verifies tenant-context audit evidence; worker proof verifies job lifecycle and denial audit evidence.
secretBoundary: Runtime proof does not use real secrets, production data, or external provider credentials.
tenantBoundary: API tenant mismatch and worker cross-tenant job read fail closed.

enterpriseEvidenceSupport.runtimeAssetEvidence: API and worker runtime assets are named by entry point and command; Postgres, Keycloak, Mailpit, MinIO, NATS, OpenBao, and Temporal provider asset traceability is recorded in the provider binding matrix.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.ownerLinkage: Owner, risk owner, and control owner trace through the service catalogue entries and provider registry entries for platform API, worker, Postgres, Mailpit, and deferred composed dependencies.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.auditEventProduction: Proof code requires API tenant-context evidence plus value-free provider evidence for Postgres, Keycloak, Mailpit, MinIO, NATS, OpenBao, and Temporal; worker proof also verifies job lifecycle and denial audit evidence.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.healthReadinessEvidence: Proof code requires health, readiness, and OpenAPI route exposure for the API runtime.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.tenantIsolationEvidence: Proof code requires API tenant mismatch and worker cross-tenant job read failures.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.accessControlEvidence: Proof code requires API and worker authorization failures to fail closed.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.secretBoundaryEvidence: Composed proofs use local placeholders or no credentials; safe evidence records endpoint_ref, hashes, counters, duration buckets, safe reason codes, and value-free summaries only.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.syntheticDataEvidence: Proof code uses synthetic tenant, actor, and job payload data only.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.operationalTeardownEvidence: Proof code tears down child processes, Compose resources, Postgres volumes, Mailpit messages, MinIO objects, OpenBao secrets, NATS subscriptions, and Temporal worker/client connections where applicable.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.incidentResponseEvidenceBoundary: No incident response readiness is claimed; future incident workflow evidence remains separate.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.changePromotionEvidenceBoundary: Change and promotion evidence is limited to schema validation, runtime validator output, local proof execution, git history, PR checks, and merge record.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.serviceCatalogueTraceability: Compose-backed proof links to spec/instances/compose-service/service-catalogue.json, compose/compose.dev.generated.yaml, provider registry ids, and service ids for Postgres, Keycloak, Mailpit, MinIO, NATS, OpenBao, and Temporal.
enterpriseEvidenceSupport.statementOfApplicabilitySupport: Fields support future Statement of Applicability evidence organisation only and do not claim certification.
